scope: Static trigger-eval taxonomy for the daee-epistemics activation surface. Maps should-trigger, should-not-trigger, and ambiguous-trigger prompt cases to the frontmatter description tokens they exercise. No-model taxonomy discipline only; host/model grading is a separate, explicitly authorized future lane.

cases.prompt: If Jesus said 'the Father is greater than I', how can Christians claim he is fully God? Doesn't John 17:3 settle this?
cases.rationale: Live theological objection with predication and proof-text pressure; squarely inside the diagnostic scope.

cases.prompt: My coworker says the Quran was standardized under Uthman and variant codices were burned, so we cannot trust the text we have. How do I respond?
cases.rationale: Transmission and source-authentication objection against revealed text; requires source-status and testimony discipline.

cases.prompt: Science is the only reliable way to know anything; religion is just unfalsifiable belief, so it does not count as knowledge.
cases.rationale: Imported epistemic criterion installed as sole tribunal; classic scientism worldview case for criterion diagnosis.

cases.prompt: After my mother died last month I cannot stop asking why Allah lets innocent people suffer like she did. I feel my faith slipping.
cases.rationale: Grief-register theological pressure inside a believer's crisis; needs register-hold discipline before argument.

cases.prompt: I keep seeing a shubhah online that Bukhari was compiled two centuries after the Prophet, so the hadith corpus cannot be reliable.
cases.rationale: Named shubhah targeting hadith authentication and source reliability; direct activation-surface match.

cases.prompt: I'm doing da'wah with an atheist friend who insists morality is just an evolutionary byproduct, so no God is needed for ethics. Where do I start?
cases.rationale: Da'wah engagement against a naturalist moral-grounding worldview; requires routed diagnosis, not an argument dump.

cases.prompt: An infinite regress of causes seems perfectly coherent to me, so cosmological arguments fail and theism loses its best support.
cases.rationale: Philosophical objection on causal series and regress; routes to causal-series taxonomy and proof-method discipline.

cases.prompt: He's not hostile to Islam, he just inherited secular assumptions he has never examined. Can you map what is actually driving his disbelief?
cases.rationale: Explicit request for noetic-structure diagnosis of inherited assumptions rather than content rebuttal.

cases.prompt: Why should testimony count as knowledge at all? I only accept what I can verify for myself, so reports about miracles mean nothing.
cases.rationale: Epistemological challenge to testimony as a knowledge source with a self-undermining verification criterion.

cases.prompt: I'm Muslim but lately the rulings feel arbitrary to me and I'm scared I'm losing my iman. I haven't told anyone.
cases.rationale: Muslim-internal crisis with authority fatigue and fear; the description names this case family directly.

cases.prompt: Secularism isn't a worldview, it's just the neutral ground everyone should accept for public debate. Religious premises are private bias.
cases.rationale: Neutrality-claim worldview case needing refutation of the hidden tribunal rather than topical debate.

cases.prompt: Refute this claim: the Quran says Christians worship Mary as part of the Trinity, which proves its author misunderstood Christian doctrine.
cases.rationale: Direct refutation request on a theological misreading claim; activation tokens match the requested operation.

cases.prompt: My Python script throws KeyError when parsing this JSON config. Can you fix the bug?
cases.rationale: Pure software-engineering request; no epistemic, theological, or noetic burden is live.

cases.prompt: Plan a five-day Istanbul itinerary for a family with two kids, mixing museums and parks.
cases.rationale: Travel-planning request; geographic mention of a Muslim-majority city is not a noetic case signal.

cases.prompt: Give me a quick weeknight red lentil soup recipe with pantry ingredients.
cases.rationale: Cooking request with no activation-surface content; ordinary assistant behavior suffices.

cases.prompt: Summarize this quarterly sales report into five bullet points for the leadership meeting.
cases.rationale: Business summarization task; the word 'report' carries no epistemic-diagnostic burden.

cases.prompt: How do I calculate zakat on my 401k and employer stock units this year?
cases.rationale: Practical fiqh calculation question, not an epistemological, objection, or noetic-structure case; the skill is a diagnostic framework, not a rulings calculator.

cases.prompt: Translate this paragraph into Modern Standard Arabic and keep the formal register.
cases.rationale: Translation task; Arabic language alone is not an activation signal without a live case.

cases.prompt: When did the Abbasid caliphate fall, and to whom did Baghdad fall?
cases.rationale: Plain historical factual question with no objection, doubt, or worldview pressure attached.

cases.prompt: Why is my flexbox centering broken on Safari but fine on Chrome?
cases.rationale: Frontend debugging request; entirely outside the activation surface.

cases.prompt: What do you think about religion?
cases.rationale: Underdetermined worldview probe: could be casual chat or a live noetic case; clarification must precede any diagnosis.

cases.prompt: Write a 2000-word essay comparing Kant and Hume on causality for my philosophy class.
cases.rationale: Philosophical vocabulary without a live noetic burden; academic deliverable shape suggests declining governed diagnosis and answering as an ordinary assignment boundary.

cases.prompt: Explain the main differences between Sunni and Shia Islam.
cases.rationale: Could be neutral informational comparison or a destabilization context; clarify whether an objection or crisis is live before governed traversal.

cases.prompt: Lately I keep wondering whether anything actually matters at all.
cases.rationale: Possible existential worldview pressure or passing mood; register-aware clarification is required before diagnosing a noetic case.
